purpose: Evaluate whether the release-aligned input and rolling-evaluation workflow transfers to U.S. CPI-U; this is not blind, prospective, or independent confirmation.

target.series: CPI-U, U.S. city average, all items, not seasonally adjusted
target.target_value: One-decimal 12-month change printed in the corresponding original BLS CPI news release
target.origin_clock_rule: actual BLS release timestamp for the origin CPI reference month plus one minute
target.target_release_rule: target first-release timestamp must be strictly after the origin clock

inputs.timesfm_cpi_context: first-vintage unrounded CPI-U NSA index-ratio YoY through the origin; construct the preceding 12 monthly log changes from the coherent CPI-index vintage available at that origin
inputs.supervision_and_statistical_history: official one-decimal BLS first-release YoY labels
inputs.availability_rule: unmasked observation availability must be strictly earlier than origin; unresolved values remain masked; no interpolation or carry-forward
inputs.vintage_rule: use the latest conservative source vintage satisfying the point-in-time cutoff; ALFRED daily vintages use a strict next-ET-day bound
inputs.target_training_use: an evaluation-period first-release label may enter a later outer origin's training packet only after its official release timestamp is strictly earlier than that outer origin

statistical_models.refit: once at each eligible outer origin using the contiguous official first-release YoY history strictly available before that origin
statistical_models.ar1: OLS intercept plus AR(1) coefficient on adjacent monthly pairs; recursively propagate through the requested horizon
statistical_models.failure_policy: record failed fit and missing forecasts; no retry or substitution

learned_heads.outer_origins: each planned evaluation origin with the required historical input context; origin-specific refit
learned_heads.inner_validation: the 12 most recent prior origins with h=3 labels released before the outer origin
learned_heads.validation_start: origin timestamp of the earliest of those 12 validation origins
learned_heads.inner_train_label_rule: sample origin precedes validation start, label release is strictly before validation start, and the target reference month is not any of the 12 validation h=3 target months
learned_heads.explicit_leakage_assertion: set(inner_train_target_months) intersect set(validation_h3_target_months) is empty for every outer origin
learned_heads.epoch_selection: h=3 validation MAE under the pinned training.py specification
learned_heads.final_fit: fresh same-seed initialization; refit on all eligible labels released strictly before the outer origin
learned_heads.failure_policy: retain failure and missing coverage; no fallback, retry, or post-result substitution

scoring.pairing: same target month and horizon; report model-native coverage, pairwise intersections, and ten-method common intersection
scoring.seed_rule: average five seed-specific absolute errors within an origin before averaging over origins
scoring.missing_prediction_rule: do not replace with zero; retain planned coverage denominators and report actual paired denominators

interpretation.claim_scope: a retrospective U.S. CPI cross-country replication of a release-aligned rolling workflow; no general model ranking or prospective validation
